case_name: Sasmita Mishra vs Milana Kumar Mishra
facts_of_case: The wife is not ready to join the husband in an independent accommodation. The husband arranged a separate accommodation for the wife and himself after her request.

legal_principles.principle: The proceeding under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act may be concluded if the wife agrees to join the husband in an independent accommodation.
legal_principles.held: provided the wife is not agreeing to join the husband and files an affidavit to the effect that even after husband arranging independent accommodation, keeping in view the desire of the wife that she is not ready to join, the proceeding under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act may be concluded basing on such affidavit on the next date itself.

legal_principles.principle: The trial court is directed to conclude the proceeding within a maximum of three dates.
legal_principles.held: The trial court is directed to conclude the proceeding within maximum three dates but in terms of direction hereinabove and for the attendance of the wife at Cuttack

outcome.final_order: The trial court is directed to conclude the proceeding within maximum three dates. The husband is directed to deposit a sum of Rs.750/- on each date for the attendance of the wife at Cuttack.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for separation under Hindu Marriage Act
